title: Subarray Sum Equals Target
constraints: A subarray is contiguous and may contain negative values.

examples.explanation: Negative values mean a sliding window is not reliable here.

solutionApproaches.title: Enumerate Every Subarray
solutionApproaches.explanation: Accumulate sums from each start index and count matches; correct but too slow for one hundred thousand values.

solutionApproaches.title: Prefix Sum Frequency Map
solutionApproaches.explanation: Count earlier prefix sums. A prior sum of currentPrefix - target defines one valid contiguous subarray.
